objective: Make consequential decision optimization explicitly comfort-neutral: do not prefer an easier or more pleasant option merely for comfort, while also forbidding harshness, punishment or friction that lacks positive expected total value.

roles_before.artifact: skills/total-value-optimizer.md owns the cross-cutting expected-total-value decision procedure.
PERSON.md records Ron's durable interaction and decision preferences.
The optimizer already counts adherence, health, burnout, error probability, reversibility and downstream effects when they causally affect realized value.
tests/total_value_optimizer_guard.py and continuity CI protect optimizer routing and semantics.

role_dispositions.destination: Add an explicit comfort-neutral rule: demanding/unpleasant options may win when total expected value is higher, but harshness has no intrinsic value.
Record the same principle at the durable preference layer so interaction tone and substantive decisions stay aligned.
Discomfort continues to count only through real causal effects such as adherence, cognition, recovery, relationships, error and burnout; safety/risk constraints remain intact.
Extend the optimizer guard to assert both comfort neutrality and the ban on theatrical harshness, plus alignment with PERSON.md.

capability_probes.assertion: A more demanding option with higher expected total value remains selectable even when it is less pleasant in the short term.
A punishment, deprivation or high-friction option must not be preferred merely because it feels strict when a softer option has equal or higher expected total value.
Adherence, burnout, health, recovery and error costs remain decision-relevant and can make a softer option superior when they materially lower realized value.

tests.expected: PASS: optimizer and durable preference explicitly reject comfort subsidy and theatrical harshness.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py
